card.name: Section number 5 in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit 5 (sometimes 1) that opens a section number inside parentheses, mainly in "Warnings and Precautions (5.x)" cross-references in drug labels. A few hits are other numbers or words, such as a COPD stage number or the word "parameter".

modes.label: Warnings and Precautions number
modes.description: The digit 5 starting a section number after "Warnings and Precautions (" in a bracketed cross-reference.
modes.example: see Contraindications (4) and Warnings and Precautions (<<5>>.1) ] . WARNING: C

modes.label: Other list numbers or terms
modes.description: Occasional hits on a stage number in a disease table or a word naming a parameter in technical text.
modes.example: Obstructive Lung Disease (GOLD):1 |Mild COPD (stage <<1>>)||80% or higher. People
